title: Symbolic maths verification (CAS round-trip)
description: Re-evaluate every numeric/algebraic answer with a CAS engine before the worksheet renders. Mismatches surface as a teacher-only banner: the question, the AI's answer, the CAS evaluation, and a 'regenerate' affordance. Kills the #1 trust issue with AI-generated maths sheets.
rationale: User's improvement #14. Today the AI says '2x + 6 = 14 → x = 5' and is rarely audited. A nightly eval harness (Phase A · PR-5) catches systematic drift, but doesn't help the teacher who clicks Generate at 7:45am. A per-render CAS pass is cheap (mathjs is already a transitive dep — the worksheet bank uses it for unit conversions), runs in 50–200ms for a typical sheet, and is the only quality bar that genuinely changes the trust narrative.
constraints: Must work fully client-side. No new server endpoint. The CAS pass cannot block worksheet render — it runs after `setGenerated` and patches metadata when it returns.
Must NOT regenerate the worksheet automatically — the teacher decides. Auto-regenerating would mask the underlying prompt bug.
Must NOT touch question content — only annotate metadata.mathsVerification.
Must NOT throw — every CAS error is captured and reported as 'unverified', not as a failure.
steps: Add `mathjs` to the explicit deps list (it's already a transitive dep via katex's tooling, but list it so a future tree-shake doesn't drop it). Confirm the bundle stays under +60kb gzipped.
- extractAnswerExpressions(question): { kind: 'numeric'|'expression'|'equation'|'unknown'; lhs?: string; rhs?: string; expected: string; raw: string }[]
Parses the AI-emitted answer text to find: numeric only ('= 5'), simplifiable expression ('= 3x + 6'), full equation ('x = 5'), or 'unknown' for prose.
- verifyOne({lhs, rhs, expected, kind}, question): { status: 'ok'|'mismatch'|'unverified'; cas?: string; reason?: string }.

Use mathjs's `simplify`, `evaluate`, and `solve` (custom — mathjs has no built-in solve, write a thin shim using algebra-rules-engine fallback OR mark as unverified). For numeric checks: substitute given values into the question's expression, compare to expected with a relative tolerance of 1e-9.

- runMathsVerification(worksheet): VerificationReport — iterates every question whose section.type is in {'numeric','algebra','calculation','wordprob'}, returns { perQuestion: {...}; counts: { ok, mismatch, unverified } }. Pure function, no I/O.

Wire it: in `client/src/lib/ai/generate.ts`, after the existing post-validator chain, run `runMathsVerification` only when `subject` matches /maths|mathematics/i and the worksheet has any of those section types. Stamp `metadata.mathsVerification` with the report. ALSO push individual mismatch warnings into `metadata.postValidatorWarnings` (so the existing teacher banner picks them up).

WorksheetRenderer.tsx: under the existing teacher-banner area, add a new compact panel `MathsVerificationPanel` that renders the report. If counts.mismatch > 0, the header is amber and lists each failing question with: 'Q3: 4x = 12 → AI says x = 4, CAS says x = 3'. A 'Regenerate' button next to each entry calls a new `regenerateQuestion(questionIndex)` callback (passed as prop from Worksheets.tsx). If no mismatches, the panel is collapsed by default with a small green tick.

Add `regenerateQuestion` in Worksheets.tsx: takes questionIndex, calls aiEditSection on that single section with a system instruction 'A CAS pass detected a mismatch — produce a corrected question + answer and explain the error in the teacher key.' Keeps the rest of the worksheet untouched.

Eval-harness integration: extend FEAT-PR5's runner.ts (Phase A · PR-5) so any maths fixture also reports counts.mismatch. Treat counts.mismatch > 0 as a soft fail (warning, not error) — the eval baseline is meant to surface trends, not block PRs.
- client/src/lib/__tests__/mathsVerifier.test.ts — covers: numeric ok, numeric mismatch, equation solve, simplifiable expression, malformed answer (graceful 'unverified'), units passthrough.
- Snapshot of WorksheetRenderer with a 1-mismatch fixture confirming the amber banner + Regenerate button render.
do_not_touch: questionPostValidator.ts (already runs — chain via the same registry)
Any AI prompt string (CAS is a deterministic post-process; prompt unchanged)
ClassPackDialog or any class-pack flow (CAS runs once on generate; class-pack reuses the same metadata)
acceptance_criteria: Generating a maths worksheet with a deliberately wrong answer (test fixture) surfaces an amber teacher banner listing the mismatch.
Regenerate-question button on the panel produces a corrected question + answer without re-rolling the entire worksheet.
Non-maths worksheets (English / Geography / etc.) skip CAS entirely (no metadata.mathsVerification).
CAS pass adds < 250ms to a 12-question maths sheet on a mid-range Chromebook.
Tests: mathsVerifier.test.ts passes; WorksheetRenderer snapshot updated.
pnpm run check + pnpm run build + pnpm test --run pass.
verification: pnpm run build (check bundle size diff)
Manual: Y9 quadratic worksheet — confirm green tick. Inject a wrong answer via fixture — confirm amber banner.
context_budget_for_fresh_chat: MEDIUM. Read mathjs docs link from package-lock; otherwise narrow ranges only.
